user.title: Acquevenete
user.description: Enter your portal login (e-mail and password), your supply number, and optionally the week-chart page value. The webapi token is obtained automatically at login and refreshed when it expires.

error.no_data: Logged in, but no readings were returned

init.title: Water price
init.description: Used to build the cost history shown in the Energy dashboard (statistic `acquevenete:<supply>_cost`). Pick an entity holding the price per m³, or type a fixed price. The current price is applied to the whole history.
